notes.type_correctness: All PixiJS v8 API calls use correct signatures; NoiseFilter cast via 'as unknown as Filter' is the documented pattern for filter interop. createGameState signature extension with _gameMode/_playMode defaulted params is type-safe. One minor issue: the introduced _gameMode/_playMode params triggered a new lint error (no-unused-vars) requiring an eslintrc fix.
notes.pattern_adherence: Ticker callback uses (ticker: Ticker) => void matching v8 pattern. Dust pool avoids per-frame heap allocation (pre-allocated 60 Graphics, mutated in place). NoiseFilter wrapped in try/catch for Canvas fallback — matches existing BlurFilter pattern in main.ts. Slight deviation: scenarios.ts import from ui/ layer is technically a boundary cross but architect-confirmed safe since scenarios.ts has no DOM/PixiJS deps.
notes.test_coverage: 29 mainMenu tests cover: construction, ticker registration, flushActions drain, MARATHON/MONOCHROME/SPRINT/EXIT buttons, onExit/onSprintStart callbacks, destroy lifecycle, noir visual node presence, and resize at min/max viewports. Typewriter/blink tick path covered by the ticker callback smoke test. No test for the 2x2 grid layout path (width < 480) — minor gap.
notes.security: No network calls, no localStorage, no eval, no user input echoed to DOM. Playfair Display font loaded via standard Google Fonts link in index.html (preload + stylesheet). NoiseFilter seed uses Math.random() — not a security concern for visual grain. No new attack surface introduced.
notes.architectural_alignment: attachPostProcess correctly deferred to intro→playing edge (main.ts line 430), not at startup. mainMenu.ts stays within ui/ layer; only imports engine/types.js and engine/scenarios.js (confirmed safe — no DOM/PixiJS in scenarios.ts). splashScreen.ts orphan left untouched per architect guidance. Dust and grain effects live entirely in ui/mainMenu.ts, not in renderer/
